documents:
task: I want a park for kids
category: parks
place_name: Basil Griffin Park
address: 2055 Three Springs Rd Bowling Green KY
phone: 270-842-5302
website: https://www.warrencountyky.gov/parks
who_it_helps: families, kids, walkers, dog owners
what_to_do: Use Basil Griffin for playgrounds, lake views, walking, sports, and family outings.
what_to_bring: water, sunscreen, snacks, stroller if needed
local_reality: Basil Griffin is a strong family park, but it is far from central Bowling Green for no-car users.
transportation_reality: Usually difficult without a car because of distance and road design.
best_for: kids, families, dogs, walking, sports
warning: Plan shade, heat, and the return trip.
keywords: park kids family basil griffin dogs walking sports lake
source_name: Warren County Parks

task: I want a park near WKU
category: parks
place_name: Preston Miller Park
address: 2303 Tomblinson Way Bowling Green KY
phone: 270-393-3249
website: https://www.bgky.org/parks
who_it_helps: families, students, walkers, sports users
what_to_do: Use Preston Miller for walking, playgrounds, sports fields, and a more central park option.
what_to_bring: water, sunscreen, sports gear if needed
local_reality: More practical for some central or WKU-area residents than outer county parks.
transportation_reality: Possible without a car for some, but check sidewalks and route.
best_for: kids, walking, sports, near WKU, families
warning: Heat and road crossings matter even for short trips.
keywords: park kids preston miller walking sports wku family
source_name: City of Bowling Green Parks

task: I need a quiet place to walk
category: parks
place_name: Fountain Square Park
address: Downtown Bowling Green KY
phone: 270-393-3000
website: https://www.bgky.org
who_it_helps: newcomers, walkers, downtown workers, students
what_to_do: Use the downtown square for a short walk, sitting, people-watching, and nearby errands.
what_to_bring: water, comfortable shoes
local_reality: This is not a big nature park, but it can be a reachable public space during errands.
transportation_reality: One of the more realistic public spaces without a car.
best_for: quiet time, downtown, walking, errands
warning: Events and traffic can make it less quiet.
keywords: park downtown fountain square quiet walking no car
source_name: City of Bowling Green
